input.description: The inference request the remote service model receives.

output.description: The typed completion the remote service model emits.

lifecycle.install: Provision the remote service endpoint and register the model reference.
lifecycle.start: Start the remote service and wait for it to accept requests.
lifecycle.healthCheck: Poll the service health endpoint until it reports ready.
lifecycle.update: Roll the remote service to the pinned model version.
lifecycle.remove: Deregister the model reference and release the remote resources.

fallback: When the remote service is unavailable, abstain and defer to a local model.
